en: Colorized vintage street view of a spa town promenade. On the left stands a large multi‑story classical building with green shutters and manicured trees in front. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the wide avenue, while a horse‑drawn carriage moves down the center. The street is lined with trees and elegant buildings, with a red‑roofed structure visible in the distance. The caption at the top reads "Bad Elster."
